groups.name: Motion limited to transitions only
groups.definition: Does the page use CSS transitions for motion while having no keyframe animations or transforms?

groups.name: Single inline style block, no external CSS
groups.definition: Is all styling in one inline style block with no linked external stylesheets?

groups.name: Few custom non-utility class names
groups.definition: Does the page use a small set of hand-named classes rather than utility-framework classes?

groups.name: Link-dense relative to text
groups.definition: Does the page have many anchors relative to its word count?

groups.name: Lightweight page without scripts or SVGs
groups.definition: Is the page free of scripts, external stylesheets and inline SVGs?
